interface: Combinational evaluation of immutable aligned six-channel statistics and frozen per-pulse configuration; caller owns snapshot and latching
energy_format: Unsigned 46-bit sum of IQ16 I^2+Q^2 over the window
noise_energy_format: Unsigned 46-bit expected noise energy over the SAME window; external qualified estimator; zero or unknown rejects
snr_format: Unsigned 32-bit Q16 linear excess-signal/noise ratio, NOT dB; 65536 represents SNR=1, 0 represents SNR=0
snr_comparison: energy*65536 >= noise_energy*(65536+min_snr_q16); 79-bit product, no division or underflow
selection: All three frozen_stats_done and validated unique permutation required; highest calibrated gain whose H and V both qualify; no default LOW
binding_policy: Physical mapping and calibration values remain outside core; simulation fixtures do not validate production binding
